The closest match is [1], which directly addresses how providers can understand why their items do or do not get exposure in recommendation lists by explaining item exposure at a system level. [1] It proposes a surrogate model that approximates the exposure distribution of a recommender and uses feature contributions to identify the factors driving recommendation decisions across users. [1]

If you want broader diagnostic tools, [2] frames recommender observability as a counterfactual measurement problem for content creators and model developers, and [5] describes an agentic system that surfaces patterns in where recommendations perform well or poorly. [2, 5]
